prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: single square app icon for an independent Chinese knitting row counter for a small narrow triangular neck scarf, called 苏菲·一行一记. Create ONE finished icon, not a comparison sheet.
Subject: a cozy berry-red knitted narrow neck scarf tied in one simple loose knot, two short tapering triangular ends, arranged as a compact elegant emblem. No human or mannequin. Strong recognizable scarf silhouette, soft rounded sculptural yarn texture with only a few clearly readable garter stitch ribs. A small loop of yarn flowing from one end subtly suggests progress.
Style: tactile soft 3D illustration, refined contemporary craft app branding, calm warmth, controlled soft shadows, no glossy plastic.
Colors: muted berry red #B0566B scarf on uniform opaque warm cream #F7F1E8 full-bleed background.
Composition: front view, square 1:1 ideally 1024x1024, one centered large symbol occupying 68-72% of canvas. Keep 14% clear safe margin on all sides; readable at 48px. Background extends to all four corners, do not draw rounded app tile corners, border, frame, or outer white margins.
Constraints: fully opaque, no lettering, numerals, watermark, badges, QR codes, promotional claims, platform logos, PetiteKnit branding, extra decorative objects. Original icon only.
